title: hydrolog-network/1
description: River network read by `route network` (ADR-0010, ADR-0012): subcatchments (with their discharges, or making them from a watershed, a runoff model and a rainfall), reaches and reservoirs, junctions and one outlet, linked by `from`. A reach has a `method` and the options of `route <method>`. `schema` is required. A `rainfall` at the top is the rain of the subcatchments that have none; `timestep_min` fixes the time step of the network.

timestep_min.description: Time step of the network [min]; default that of the sources, else 5.

id.description: Names the node and its file `<id>.csv`: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-` and not ending with `.`, not a device name of Windows (`con`, `prn`, `aux`, `nul`, `com1` to `com9`, `lpt1` to `lpt9`, any case, any extension); unique without regard to case.

from.description: The ids of the nodes that flow into this one.

times_min.description: Times of the ordinates [min], strictly increasing at a regular step, the same step and first time for every subcatchment; with `discharge_m3s`.

discharge_m3s.description: Discharge at each time [m3/s], not negative; as many values as `times_min`.

value_column.description: Column of `inflows_file` with the discharges [m3/s] of the subcatchment; default the `id`. Not with inline discharges.

from.description: The ids of the nodes that flow into this one.

initial_outflow_m3s.description: Outflow at the first ordinate [m3/s], not negative; default the first inflow ordinate (steady state).

extend_min.description: Time added after the last inflow ordinate, whose value is held [min], not negative; 0 adds nothing. Default: until the outflow has settled (within 0.1 % of the inflow peak), at most ten times the inflow duration.

lag_min.description: Lag [min]: how much later the outflow repeats the inflow; > 0. A lag that is not a whole number of time steps is interpolated (`lag_interpolated`).

k_min.description: Travel time K of the reach [min]; > 0 (about the reach length divided by the flood-wave celerity).

x.description: Weighting factor X, 0 to 0.5: 0 is a linear reservoir (maximum attenuation), 0.5 passes the wave on without attenuation.

subreaches.description: Number of equal sub-reaches of K/N, at least 1; default K/step rounded. Each keeps the weights non-negative for 2KX/step <= N <= 2K(1-X)/step.

manning_n.description: Manning's roughness [s/m^(1/3)]; > 0. With `bottom_width_m` it describes the section, instead of `celerity_m_per_s` and `top_width_m`.

bottom_width_m.description: Bottom width of the section [m]; >= 0 (0: a triangle). With `manning_n`.

side_slope_m_per_m.description: Bank slope [m/m]: horizontal metres per vertical metre; >= 0 (0: a rectangle); default 0. Part of the section, ignored with `celerity_m_per_s`.

celerity_m_per_s.description: Flood-wave celerity at the reference discharge [m/s]; > 0. With `top_width_m`, instead of the section.

top_width_m.description: Width of the water surface at the reference discharge [m]; > 0. With `celerity_m_per_s`.

reference_discharge_m3s.description: Reference discharge [m3/s] at which the celerity and the width are taken; > 0; default the inflow peak.

n.description: Number of reservoirs in series; > 0, need not be whole. n = 1 is one reservoir (the most attenuation), a large n is a pure delay of the wave.

k_min.description: Storage constant K of one reservoir [min]; > 0; the reach delays the wave by n K. Instead of `length_km` and `celerity_m_per_s`.

length_km.description: Length of the reach [km]; > 0. With `celerity_m_per_s`, instead of `k_min`: K = L/(n c).

watershed.title: watershed
watershed.description: The area of a subcatchment: the fields of `WatershedParameters`, as in `hydrograph generate`. The `curve-number` runoff needs `cn` and, unless it is given `tc_min`, the fields of its `tc_method`.

oneOf.title: runoff curve-number
oneOf.description: The SCS Curve Number loss and a unit hydrograph, with the options of `hydrograph generate`.

tc_min.description: Time of concentration [min]; > 0. Needed by the scs and clark models; when omitted it is computed for a watershed by `tc_method`. The nash and snyder models do not use it.

tc_method.description: Method for computing tc from a watershed when `tc_min` is not given; default kirpich. The watershed fields a method needs: see `tc watershed`.

ia_coefficient.description: Initial abstraction ratio λ (Ia = λ·S), 0 < λ <= 1; default 0.2 (the standard the CN tables are calibrated for).

uh_model.description: Unit hydrograph model; default scs. Model options: `nash_*`, `clark_*`, `snyder_*`.

nash_n.description: Nash: number of reservoirs n (> 0, typically 1-10); together with `nash_k_min`. `uh nash` derives parameters by the Lutz method.

nash_k_min.description: Nash: storage constant K [min] (> 0, typically 10-200); together with `nash_n`.

clark_r_min.description: Clark: storage constant R [min] (> 0); alternative to `clark_r_tc_ratio`.

clark_r_tc_ratio.description: Clark: ratio R/tc (> 0, typically 0.2-1.5), R = ratio · tc; alternative to `clark_r_min`.

snyder_length_km.description: Snyder: main stream length L [km] (> 0); together with `snyder_centroid_length_km`.

snyder_centroid_length_km.description: Snyder: length from the outlet to the catchment centroid Lc [km] (> 0).

oneOf.title: design storm
oneOf.description: A depth over a duration, in the shape of a hyetograph.

hietogram_type.description: Temporal distribution of the rainfall; `alpha`, `beta` apply to beta, `peak_position` to triangular and euler_ii.

duration_min.description: Rainfall duration [min]; > 0 and not shorter than the time step. The hyetograph has `int(duration_min / timestep_min)` steps; when the duration is not a multiple of the step the tail is not covered (a notice reports it).

alpha.description: Parameter α of the Beta distribution (shape of the rising limb), > 0; only for `beta`; default 2. The pair (2; 5) gives an early peak (convective storm), (2; 2) a symmetric one, (5; 2) a late one.

beta.description: Parameter β of the Beta distribution (shape of the falling limb), > 0; only for `beta`; default 5.

peak_position.description: Relative position of the peak within the duration, 0 < p < 1 (exclusive); only for `triangular` (default 0.5) and `euler_ii` (default 0.33).

oneOf.title: rainfall series
oneOf.description: The depth of every time step. It is not resampled: the network takes its time step.

depths_mm.description: Depth of each step [mm], not negative.
